verify_detail: r is odd, simulating a "sync unavailable" state. Since nothing resets that counter between test runs, whether the assertion sees the button depends on parity of accumulated launches — not on any real timing race, network condition, or animation. Fix options: either clear app data before each test run (forces `launchCount=0`, deterministically even), or have the test/BVT harness ignore or account for the odd-launch "Sync unavailable" state rather than hard-asserting the button is always visible.'
